---
title: "Tutorials"
---

```{css, echo=FALSE}
:root {
  --cf-bg-page: #F1F8E9;
  --cf-card-bg: #FFFFFF;
  --cf-primary: #2E7D32;
  --cf-secondary: #558B2F;
  --cf-accent: #EF6C00;
  --cf-text-main: #1B5E20;
  --cf-text-light: #52665A;
  --cf-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.15);
}
.tutorial-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  gap: 2rem;
  padding: 2rem 0;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
}
.tutorial-card {
  background: var(--cf-card-bg);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 2rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border: 1px solid rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.1);
  border-left: 5px solid var(--cf-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--cf-shadow);
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.tutorial-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: 0 15px 35px -10px rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.25);
  border-color: var(--cf-secondary);
}
.card-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
}
.card-icon {
  color: var(--cf-secondary);
  background-color: #E8F5E9;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.card-badge {
  background-color: var(--cf-bg-page);
  color: var(--cf-primary);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  border: 1px solid rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.2);
}
.card-title {
  color: var(--cf-text-main);
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 0.75rem 0;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.card-description {
  color: var(--cf-text-light);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  flex-grow: 1;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}
.card-cta-button {
  background-color: var(--cf-primary);
  color: white !important;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-align: center;
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
  align-self: flex-start;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.card-cta-button:hover {
  background-color: var(--cf-secondary);
  text-decoration: none;
  transform: translateX(4px);
}
.tutorial-card svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
.card-cta-button.is-soon {
  background-color: #C8D6C0;
  color: #52665A !important;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.card-cta-button.is-soon:hover { background-color: #C8D6C0; transform: none; }
.card-badge.is-step { background-color: var(--cf-accent); color: #FFFFFF; border-color: var(--cf-accent); }
.card-badge.is-model { background-color: #1565C0; color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #1565C0; }
.card-badge.is-rap { background-color: #6A1B9A; color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #6A1B9A; }
.section-intro { color: var(--cf-text-light); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 760px; }
.section-card {
  background: var(--cf-card-bg);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 2rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.15);
  border-left: 6px solid var(--cf-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--cf-shadow);
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: block;
}
.section-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 15px 35px -10px rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.25); text-decoration: none; }
.section-card h3 { margin-top: 0; color: var(--cf-primary); font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; }
.section-card p { color: var(--cf-text-light); font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
.section-count {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--cf-primary);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 3px 12px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.section-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  gap: 2rem;
  padding: 2rem 0;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
}
.section-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background-color: var(--cf-primary);
  color: white !important;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
}
.section-cta:hover { background-color: var(--cf-secondary); text-decoration: none; }
```

```{r setup, eval=FALSE}
```

```{=html}
<p class="section-intro">climasus4r offers a complete ecosystem of tutorials for researchers in environmental epidemiology and public health. Explore the five tracks below — each one leads to a dedicated hub with in-depth tutorials.</p>

<div class="section-grid">

  <a class="section-card" href="https://bymaxanjos.github.io/climasus4r/en/articles/hub-pipeline.html">
    <span class="section-count">9 tutorials</span>
    <h3>9-Stage Pipeline Track</h3>
    <p>From importing DATASUS data to epidemiological modeling. Each stage corresponds to a phase of the integrated health, climate, and environment pipeline — follow them in order to build your complete pipeline.</p>
    <span class="section-cta">Explore Track →</span>
  </a>

  <a class="section-card" href="https://bymaxanjos.github.io/climasus4r/en/articles/hub-modelagem.html">
    <span class="section-count">8 tutorials</span>
    <h3>Advanced Modeling (<code>sus_mod_*</code>)</h3>
    <p>DLNM, attributable burden, case-crossover, multi-city pooling, machine learning, Bayesian spatial models, and SWOT vulnerability analysis. Recommended prerequisite: Stage 9 of the Track.</p>
    <span class="section-cta">Explore Modeling →</span>
  </a>

  <a class="section-card" href="https://bymaxanjos.github.io/climasus4r/en/articles/hub-tematicos.html">
    <span class="section-count">8 tutorials</span>
    <h3>Thematic Tutorials</h3>
    <p>Introductory tutorial, INMET data and ML-based gap filling, bioclimatic indices, climate-health aggregation strategies, heatwaves and cold waves. Perfect for deepening specific skills.</p>
    <span class="section-cta">Explore Thematic →</span>
  </a>

  <a class="section-card" href="https://bymaxanjos.github.io/climasus4r/en/articles/tutorial_estudos_casos.html">
    <span class="section-count">4 case studies</span>
    <h3>Case Studies in Climate Epidemiology</h3>
    <p>Complete pipelines with real DATASUS + INMET data: pediatric respiratory mortality (SIM-DO), dengue in the Northeast (SINAN), cardiovascular mortality in older adults and heatwaves, hospitalizations and cold waves in the South (SIH).</p>
    <span class="section-cta">View Case Studies →</span>
  </a>

  <a class="section-card" href="https://bymaxanjos.github.io/climasus4r/en/articles/hub-rap.html">
    <span class="section-count">3 tutorials</span>
    <h3>Reproducible Analytical Pipelines (<code>sus_rap_*</code>)</h3>
    <p>Export, share, and re-run analyses as Reproducible Analytical Pipelines. Covers export, integration with <code>targets</code>, YAML recipes, a Shiny GUI, and full project scaffolding.</p>
    <span class="section-cta">Explore RAPs →</span>
  </a>

</div>
```
